text:
sasha: Heads-up — customer reported a billing spike when a streaming call gets client-truncated and the client reconnects. Toolcall tokens look double-billed in ledger. Repro logs below. Anyone seen this before?

ravi: Paste the router/backend snippets if you have them.

sasha: Minimal repro: 
```
[router] recv stream init id=abc123 session=zz1
[backend] toolcall.fire tool=translate idempotency=null session=zz1 -> SUCCESS tokens=120
[client] TCP FIN (early-eof)
[client] reconnect stream init session=zz1_reconnect
[router] resume-> backend (new session id)
[backend] toolcall.fire tool=translate session=zz1_reconnect -> SUCCESS tokens=120
```
Router treats reconnect as new session so toolcall executed twice.

maia: Two root causes: 1) no idempotency token on toolcall so dedupe is impossible; 2) billing marks toolcall tokens as CONFIRMED immediately on SUCCESS even though stream wasn't finalized.

leo: Idea: mark mid-stream toolcall billing events PROVISIONAL. Only flip to CONFIRMED on final chunk ack / stream close. That prevents immediate double invoices on reconnect replays.

ravi: Sounds reasonable but we need TTL/cleanup — provisional credits shouldn't live forever if the backend dies. We already have a 5m tombstone for provisional snapshots; can we reuse that?

maia: Yes. Proposed flow: emit billing event {status: PROVISIONAL, session_id, toolcall_id}. On stream finalization emit {status: CONFIRM, toolcall_id}. Billing pipeline only invoices CONFIRM; provisional events are retained for 5m then dropped. We'll add a reconcile job to backfill historical cases.

leo: For deterministic dedupe we must carry a stable toolcall id. Suggest clients send X-Toolcall-Id header; if missing router generates one and forwards it. Also keep orig_session_id when router rewrites session ids on resume so matching is easier.

ravi: Backwards compatibility: accept client-provided id else generate. Router caches recent toolcall ids for 30s to dedupe within the routing layer; ledger does final dedupe based on toolcall_id. Feature-flag the new path initially.

ops-bot: Billing alert: account=acme-prod triggered stream_retry_spike_threshold.

maia: Console change: show provisional vs confirmed token breakdown in request trace UI. Current aggregate hides provisional spikes. I'll mock a small badge + breakdown.

leo: Dev tasks: 
- Router: forward/generate X-Toolcall-Id, propagate orig_session_id on resume, ringbuffer TTL dedupe (30s)
- Billing: schema add PROVISIONAL/CONFIRM, hold provisional 5m before drop, bill only on CONFIRM
- Reconcile job for existing spikes (ledger-side)
- Console: provisional token column in traces + hover copy
- E2E: harness to simulate early-eof + reconnect + toolcall duplicate

ravi: Add metrics: toolcall.provisional_count, toolcall.confirmed_count, toolcall.dedupe_hits. Gate rollout on metrics.

sasha: Quick POC header: 
POST /v1/stream
X-Toolcall-Id: 6b7f-1a2b
Body: { ... }
Router/backend should echo toolcall id in traces so we can assert equality.

maia: I'll own billing schema PR + console mock. leo take router. ravi add metrics + reconcile job. sasha attach full logs/account to the incident ticket so billing can pause refunds until dedupe is in place.

sasha: Attached logs to ticket. Also noticed router rewrite of session ids (zz1 -> zz1_reconnect) which prevents naive string-match dedupe; propagate orig_session_id to avoid this.

leo: Will include orig_session_id header on resume.

ravi: Suggest feature-flag rollout per account; toggle on for affected customers first.

maia: Agreed, feature flag + metric gating.

sasha: Checklist: 
- [ ] Router: X-Toolcall-Id + orig_session_id + dedupe cache (leo)
- [ ] Billing: PROVISIONAL/CONFIRM schema + 5m hold (maia)
- [ ] Reconcile job (ravi)
- [ ] Console UX + PR (maia)
- [ ] Metrics instrumentation (ravi)
- [ ] E2E tests (ravi+leo)
- [ ] Audit adapter-side retries for hidden retries (ravi)

billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-3245 to hold provisional credits for acme-prod until reconcile completes.

sasha: Thanks all. Will monitor account and close once RFC + PRs land.
